primary.title: Quotations from Chairman Mao Tse-tung
primary.author: Mao Zedong
primary.rationale: This is a collection of Mao's writings and speeches, widely disseminated and influential. It is a key primary source for understanding his ideology and the Cultural Revolution.

primary.title: On Protracted War
primary.author: Mao Zedong
primary.rationale: A seminal work outlining Mao's strategic thinking on guerrilla warfare and the protracted nature of the Sino-Japanese War. Crucial for understanding his military and political theories.

primary.title: Selected Works of Mao Tse-tung
primary.author: Mao Zedong
primary.rationale: A comprehensive collection of Mao's most important writings, speeches, and letters, spanning his political career. Essential for in-depth research.

secondary.title: Mao: The Unknown Story
secondary.author: Jung Chang and Jon Halliday
secondary.rationale: A highly critical and widely read biography that offers a controversial perspective on Mao's life and rule, based on extensive interviews and archival research.

secondary.title: Mao Zedong and China in the Twentieth-Century World: A Concise History
secondary.author: Rebecca E. Karl
secondary.rationale: A scholarly and accessible overview of Mao's life and impact within the broader context of 20th-century global history, written by a respected historian.

secondary.title: The Cambridge Companion to Mao Zedong
secondary.author: Rebecca E. Karl and Laura A. Storti (Editors)
secondary.rationale: A collection of essays by leading scholars providing diverse perspectives on Mao's thought, actions, and legacy.

suggestions.notes: Primary source texts by Mao are often available in various editions and translations online, particularly on Internet Archive. Secondary sources are chosen for their scholarly reputation and publication date post-Mao's death.
